summary: Tested new admin Delivery Fees stats feature. Backend endpoint GET /api/admin/stats/delivery-fees passes all auth, shape, range-param and aggregation-correctness tests (7/7). Frontend page /admin/stats/delivery loads correctly after login with all required data-testids (sidebar link, page container, 4 KPI cards, 5 range chips, chart svg, journal rows). Regression checks on /admin, /admin/orders, /admin/menu, /admin/settings all clean.

issues: Recharts logs a benign console warning about initial container width/height (-1) on first mount — resolves once ResponsiveContainer measures. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1143 lines — nearing threshold; consider splitting admin/orders/stats into routers.
delivery-fees endpoint reads up to 20000 delivery docs into memory and aggregates in Python; fine for MVP but should migrate to Mongo aggregation pipeline once volume grows.

datetime.fromisoformat with .replace('Z','+00:00') assumes ISO string; naive strings without tz will be treated as local — acceptable given seed_admin/order creation always stores ISO Z. Consider defensive handling for older docs.
seed_data_creation: 5 synthetic orders inserted via pymongo into db.orders with ids test-stat-1..5 during aggregation test; cleaned up in finally block (verified via delete_many prefix match).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_stats.py covers auth, shape, range validation, and aggregation with mongo seeding (uses order_number uuid to bypass unique index). Frontend testids confirmed: admin-nav-delivery-stats, delivery-stats-page, delivery-stats-kpi-{today,this_week,this_month,all_time}, delivery-stats-range-{7,14,30,90,365}, delivery-stats-chart, delivery-stats-row-YYYY-MM-DD.
